name: Tourism Visa / E-Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Bolivia's official consular visa taxonomy (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, cancilleria.gob.bo) groups nationalities into three tiers: Group I does not require a Tourism Visa at all (primarily South American and other agreement-partner countries). All entrants must complete SIGEMIG online registration within 7 days of arrival (accommodation and emergency-contact details) as part of the 2026 digital-processing overhaul, and carry a yellow fever certificate if arriving from an endemic-risk area.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm Group I status for your nationality, then complete SIGEMIG registration within 7 days of arrival.

requirements.blocker_text: Group II nationalities (per a tier-4 travel-industry source, including China, Taiwan, and Iran) can obtain a Tourism Visa on arrival. A 2026 e-visa system was also introduced: a single-entry online visa valid for a 90-day stay, extendable once for another 90 days, applied for in advance with passport details, flight itinerary, and hotel reservation.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the e-visa online in advance, or obtain the visa on arrival if eligible, then complete SIGEMIG registration within 7 days.

requirements.blocker_text: Group III nationalities require a Tourism Visa obtained in advance, with prior consultation required from DIGEMIG (the national migration authority) before issuance. Reported cost around USD 160 per a tier-4 source; not independently confirmed against a fee schedule.
requirements.fix_path: Apply through a Bolivian consulate, allowing time for DIGEMIG's prior consultation before the visa is issued.

evidence_required.document: Yellow fever certificate (if arriving from endemic-risk area)
SIGEMIG registration within 7 days of arrival

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days, extendable once for another 90 days (e-visa); shorter for some on-arrival categories

sources.title: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia (official consular portal) -- full visa-category taxonomy including Tourism Visa group structure and common document requirements
Travel and Tour World (trade press) -- 2026 e-visa system rollout, SIGEMIG registration requirement, Group I/II/III nationality tiers
